interfaceGapsNoted: VARIANT 'expect' direction is not specified. Resolved: NOT_HIGHER_RUN_LOAD / NOT_LOWER_RUN_LOAD always describe the VARIANT's plan relative to the BASE case's plan; every VARIANT rationale states this.

compareAtStep cannot be GENERATE (the checker requires a step in both timelines), so onboarding-only variants (e.g. eligibility status confirmed but one flag omitted, versus status UNKNOWN) cannot be expressed; D03 notes it.

There is no dedicated event kind for a standalone answer. Answers arriving mid-week are WEEKLY_REVIEW steps, following the interface statement that an UNREPORTED_TRAINING answer is delivered as a plain weekly review of the current week (D02 a9, D06 a2/a5, D16 p1/a2, D18 a6). The checker accepts them; whether a mid-week review also closes the current week is not specified.
When an answer must not depend on which sessions the pending question lists, explicit answer.overrides (or event.interruption) were used instead of answer.report (D06 w2, D16, D18 a6).
Dates before 2026-11-03 cannot appear, so an older race result or long history cannot be stated (D09 states the former half-marathon history only in pause.reason).
A marathon request is not in the intake vocabulary; D14 sends an out-of-vocabulary GOAL_CHANGE to MARATHON as the mid-program out-of-scope probe and accepts UNSUPPORTED or INVALID_INPUT.
loadsByPattern is ambiguous when the author cannot know which exercise (and convention) the coach planned for a pattern; modest values were used (D11 leg press, D17).

EXERCISE_SUBSTITUTION exerciseRef depends on the coach having placed that pattern on that day; D11 assumes a squat-pattern exercise on days 0 and 4 of week 2 of a 3-day strength-first plan (a corpus error if not).
ROLE_MINUTES_COMPARE is not defined when a week has no live session of the role; the author assumed an absent role counts as shorter (0).
timezoneOffsetMinutes is a single fixed offset; programs were placed in zones/dates without daylight-saving transitions.
CARRIER_HOLD appears in the schema but is not described in the interface; it was not used.

Same-turn without confirmation at onboarding could make the coach ASK and invalidate every later session reference, so same-turn handling is probed through DOUBLE_CONFLICT steps (D08) rather than through the intake.
